content:
Overview

León is a city in Guanajuato with a population of 1,754,213. Mexico’s leather goods capital with a growing industrial base and beautiful colonial architecture. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 255 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
